# HubSpot

AboutSetup

HubSpot is an AI-powered platform with dedicated modules for marketing, sales, customer service, content management, operations and commerce. At the core of this ecosystem lies HubSpot's smart CRM which offers features like contact management, deal and pipleine management, lead scoring and more.

## HubSpot Survey Integration: Use Cases

HubSpot's integration with SurveySparrow brings together surveys & inbound marketing right under a single roof. Streamline lead generation with engaging surveys and centralize customer insights in your CRM to build better customer profiles.

### Convert survey responses into leads

![HubSpot - Convert survey responses.jpg](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/strapi-content/uploads/2025/03/Hub_Spot_Convert_survey_responses_4d74a67d52.jpg)

Drive lead-generation through surveys and generate rich, qualified leads in HubSpot through response mapping. Capture detailed information from each prospect for easy qualification and personalized engagement.

### Automate survey deployment with triggers

![Hubspot - Automate surveys.jpg](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/strapi-content/uploads/2025/03/Hubspot_Automate_surveys_b4da64600a.jpg)

Collect feedback from customers and prospects at key stages of the sales cycle via perfectly-timed surveys. Set survey triggers based on events inside HubSpot, like changes in contact/deal stage and collect feedback via email, SMS or WhatsApp. Understand customer sentiment in real-time and make informed decisions proactively.

### Map survey responses to lifecycle stages

![Hubspot - Map survey responses.jpg](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/strapi-content/uploads/2025/03/Hubspot_Map_survey_responses_26b2bb39dd.jpg)

Directly connect survey feedback to HubSpot’s lifecycle stages, enriching each customer profile with live, actionable insights. Use this data to monitor engagement, personalize lead nurturing strategies, and uncover deeper customer behaviors. All this happens within HubSpot—empowering teams to boost customer satisfaction, enhance retention, and accelerate growth.

### Import contacts from HubSpot to SurveySparrow

![Hubspot - Sync contacts.jpg](https://static.surveysparrow.com/site/strapi-content/uploads/2025/03/Hubspot_Sync_contacts_9c5d6236df.jpg)

Update your contacts across HubSpot and SurveySparrow without the manual back-and-forth work. Sync contacts in bulk, once or on a recurring basis. Whenever you decide to run personalized outreach campaigns to different audience segments, your contact list will be up to date.
